title: dpa-review input: a structured description of one Data Processing Agreement
description: Generated from src/dpa_review/contract.py by `make docs`; docs/input-format.md explains every key. The CLI enforces this schema and, beyond it, a few cross-field rules: every transfers.mechanisms key is a listed destination, sub-processor names are unique ignoring case, spaces and punctuation, and every evidence key names a fact the input records. Input that breaks any of them exits 3.

$schema.description: The URL or path of schema/dpa.schema.json, so an editor can check and complete the file as you type. No rule reads it.

agreement.description: Name of the agreement, used as the packet title. No rule reads it.

controller.description: Name of the controller. Labels the transfer evidence graph; no rule reads it.

processor.description: Name of the processor. Labels the transfer evidence graph; no rule reads it.

roles_defined.description: Whether the DPA defines the controller and processor roles. Recorded only: no rule reads it.

processing.description: The processing details GDPR Art. 28(3) requires the DPA to set out. Read by the processing.* rules.

subject_matter.description: The subject matter of the processing is stated: true, or a short description; false, null or omitted when it is not stated. A blank string, or "false", "no", "none", "n/a", "unknown", "not specified" or "tbd" in any case, is refused. Rule processing.subject_matter.

duration.description: The duration of the processing is stated: true, or a short description; false, null or omitted when it is not stated. A blank string, or "false", "no", "none", "n/a", "unknown", "not specified" or "tbd" in any case, is refused. Rule processing.duration.

nature_and_purpose.description: The nature and purpose of the processing are stated: true, or a short description; false, null or omitted when it is not stated. A blank string, or "false", "no", "none", "n/a", "unknown", "not specified" or "tbd" in any case, is refused. Rule processing.nature_and_purpose.

data_types.description: The types of personal data processed. Rule processing.data_types: an empty or omitted list is MISSING.

data_subjects.description: The categories of data subjects. Rule processing.data_subjects: an empty or omitted list is MISSING.

art28_clauses.description: The processor clauses GDPR Art. 28(2)-(4) require. Each flag is true when the DPA contains the clause; false, null or omitted when it was not found.

process_on_documented_instructions.description: Art. 28(3)(a): the processor processes only on documented instructions. Rule art28.process_on_documented_instructions.

confidentiality_commitment.description: Art. 28(3)(b): persons authorised to process are bound to confidentiality. Rule art28.confidentiality_commitment.

security_measures_art32.description: Art. 28(3)(c): the processor takes the security measures of Art. 32. Rule art28.security_measures_art32.

subprocessor_authorization.description: Art. 28(2): "specific" (prior specific written authorisation), "general" (general written authorisation) or "none". Rule subprocessor.authorization: "none", null or omitted is MISSING. "general" also runs rule subprocessor.change_notice_and_objection.

subprocessor_change_notice_and_objection.description: Art. 28(2), second sentence, read with Art. 28(3)(d): under general written authorisation, the processor informs the controller of any intended addition or replacement of a sub-processor, giving the controller the opportunity to object. Read only when subprocessor_authorization is "general" (rule subprocessor.change_notice_and_objection).

subprocessor_flowdown.description: Art. 28(4): the same data-protection obligations are imposed on every sub-processor. Rule subprocessor.flowdown.

assist_data_subject_requests.description: Art. 28(3)(e): the processor assists with data-subject requests. Rule art28.assist_data_subject_requests.

assist_security_breach.description: Art. 28(3)(f): the processor assists with security, breach and DPIA obligations (Art. 32-36). Rule art28.assist_security_breach.

delete_or_return_on_termination.description: Art. 28(3)(g): the processor deletes or returns the data at the end of the services. Rule art28.delete_or_return_on_termination.

audit_and_inspection_rights.description: Art. 28(3)(h): the processor allows and contributes to audits and inspections. Rule art28.audit_and_inspection_rights.

breach_notification.description: Breach-notification terms (GDPR Art. 33(2)). Read by rule breach.processor_notifies.

processor_notifies_controller.description: The processor notifies the controller of a personal-data breach. Rule breach.processor_notifies.

timing.description: The notice period as the DPA words it, e.g. "without undue delay". The rule passes only wording that contains "undue delay" or "without delay"; other wording goes to review.

controller_notifies_authority_art33.description: The controller's own notice to the supervisory authority is addressed. Recorded only: no rule reads it.

subprocessors.description: Every sub-processor the DPA names or authorises. Each one outside the EEA is checked as a transfer (rule transfer.subprocessor.<name>). Record [] when there are none.

name.description: The sub-processor's name. Names must differ, ignoring case, spaces and punctuation, because rule ids are derived from them.

country.description: Upper-case ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country where it processes the data, e.g. "US" (the United Kingdom is "GB", Greece is "GR").

purpose.description: What the sub-processor does. Labels the graph; no rule reads it.

transfer_mechanism.description: The Chapter V basis for a sub-processor outside the EEA. Null or omitted reads as none.

transfers.description: Transfers of personal data that the processor makes directly to other countries.

destinations.description: Upper-case ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of every country the processor transfers personal data to directly; each is checked (rule transfer.<country>). Record [] when there are none.

mechanisms.description: The Chapter V basis per destination, keyed by a country that destinations lists. A destination without an entry reads as none.

additionalProperties.description: The Chapter V basis for this destination.

transfer_impact_assessment.description: A transfer impact assessment is recorded. Read only when SCCs or BCR are relied on (rule transfer.impact_assessment).

ccpa.description: California CCPA/CPRA terms, a secondary lens. Omitted reads as not recorded, which goes to review.

service_provider_terms.description: Service-provider terms restricting the sale and retention of personal information are present. Rule ccpa.service_provider_terms.

evidence.description: Where each recorded fact comes from in the DPA, keyed by the fact's path, e.g. {"art28_clauses.subprocessor_flowdown": {"clause": "§ 7.2", "quote": "..."}}. The packet prints it next to the findings that read the fact. A key must name a fact this input records.

additionalProperties.description: The clause and quote that support one recorded fact.

clause.description: Where the fact is in the DPA, e.g. "§ 7.2" or "Annex 3".

quote.description: The DPA's own words, quoted verbatim.
